FREESIDE

Design system source of truth. One underlying truth about the resort, disclosed at four precisions — Terrace, Atrium, Service, Ledger. Every user-facing string is projected through the Exposure doctrine rather than written into a template.

Cards · Brand

  • EnvironmentOne plate, four precisions — the media system for the inside of the cylinder
  • IconographyFine-line glyphs, unframed. No coin circles, no filled or duotone icons.
  • LockupsWordmark, tagline, and the tabular figure line — two faces, no monogram
  • WordmarkThe lockup is the only place the axial device appears. Never inline, never in a header.

Cards · Colors

  • Accent pairsA surface picks ONE pair. Components read only accent-1 and accent-2 — never past them.
  • Main paletteDeep Space Ink · Lado Sunlight · Lunar Concrete · Cannes Sky · Babylon Foliage
  • InkOne ink. Text is Deep Space Ink on light, Lado Sunlight on deep — colour is never a letterform
  • SecondaryOrganic Chic Sand · Cold Mist (silver) · Rose Brick
  • RegistersLight (Paradise) is default; Deep Space (Authority) is earned

Cards · Doctrine

  • Conformance37 checks over 276 cases — catalogue validity, fragment policy, selectors, reachability, deliberate failure, non-visual leakage
  • ExposureThe one mechanism: how much of the machine is showing, and what turns it
  • Review · Guest surfaceOne reading at four precisions, and one action whose label degrades
  • Review · Permission gateOne refusal, six contexts — silent, abstract and explicit disclosure
  • Review · RosterRows, columns and the count — and a capability grant that changes neither
  • RetrofitPutting Freeside colour into a repo that already has its own token layer — one file, no component edits

Cards · Spacing

  • Radius & formSquare by default — roundness is earned by context
  • Scale4px sub-unit, 8px rhythm
  • ElevationMineral tint + hairline first; soft ink-tinted shadow second — no glow in base

Cards · Type

  • Case & trackingWordmark 0.14em · label 0.18em uppercase · body normal
  • ScaleModular ~1.25 — wordmark 112 down to 11px micro-labels
  • Two faces, six rolesMichroma sets the wordmark and display. Archivo sets everything else, including every numeral.
